claims.claim: UK used Lens are available in our shop
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens; no origin/UK provenance is visible.
A lens photo cannot show shutter count; no camera body/EXIF/counter is shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness report does not confirm glass condition (scratches/haze/fungus) beyond general visibility; no internal inspection/test is shown.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: The witness report is about a lens only; no battery/charger is shown.

risks.risk: Lens may have hidden internal issues (haze/fungus/oil on elements) not clearly detectable from the provided angles.
risks.proof: A clear video/clip through the front element at different angles with bright light, plus a close-up of the rear element and mount contacts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible cleaning/repair needs (worst-case: haze/fungus/oil), not as 'like new'.

risks.risk: Scratches or coating damage on the glass may be present but not conclusively visible in the witness shots.
risks.proof: Macro close-ups of both front and rear glass under strong side lighting (flashlight across the surface) showing any scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially scratched/with reduced optical clarity.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps, hood, filters) or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: A single photo laid out showing all included parts: front cap, rear cap, hood (if any), filter (if any), and any paperwork.

risks.risk: Autofocus/zoom/aperture may be faulty or inconsistent even if the lens looks intact.
risks.proof: A short test clip on a compatible Canon APS-C body showing AF lock and zoom movement across the range, plus a shot demonstrating aperture changes.

risks.risk: Mount compatibility may not match the buyer’s camera (EFS is Canon APS-C; physical fit matters).
risks.proof: A photo of the exact mount from the side plus a test fit on the buyer’s camera model (or seller shows it mounted and locked).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming standard Canon EFS fit, but treated as higher risk if compatibility cannot be confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo/video of the front and rear glass under bright side lighting to check for scratches, haze, or fungus.
Send a short test video showing autofocus working and zoom moving smoothly from 18mm to 55mm.
Show a close-up of the aperture/iris blades (or a video stopping down) to confirm aperture health.
Confirm included items with a laid-out photo: front cap, rear cap, hood/filter (if any).
Show the lens mounted on a Canon APS-C body (EFS fit) and confirm it locks properly.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a Canon EFS 18-55mm lens, which is enough to price at worst-case used condition; seller claims about shutter count and battery/charger are not verifiable from the lens photos.
